title: Ghost long-form theme integration
guidance: Separate theme chrome from post-content typography
Test editor-produced tables embeds captions and footnotes
Preserve Ghost membership and navigation behavior during refinement
avoid: CSS that assumes authored HTML shapes Ghost does not emit
Replacing portable post content with theme-only markup

title: Web responsive text resilience
guidance: Allow grid and flex children to shrink with min-width zero
Provide safe wrapping for long tokens
Verify 200 percent zoom and user text scaling
avoid: Global overflow hidden that masks defects

title: React and Next.js rendering boundaries
guidance: Keep presentational components server-rendered when interaction does not require client state
Co-locate state with the smallest interactive boundary
Measure image and font effects on the first meaningful view
avoid: Turning the whole route into a client component
Animation libraries for a single CSS-capable transition

title: HTML and CSS token discipline
guidance: Define semantic roles before component-specific aliases
Keep one source for type color spacing radius and motion values
Document intentional one-off values
avoid: Token names tied to one temporary color

title: Accessible form recovery
guidance: Keep persistent labels
Connect field errors programmatically
Move focus to an error summary only when it helps recovery
Preserve entered values after failure
avoid: Clearing the form on server error

title: Reduced and interruptible motion
guidance: Treat reduced motion as a coherent alternate behavior
Ensure cancellation still lands in the correct semantic state
Prefer transform and opacity when motion is justified
avoid: Animation completion as the only state update

title: Localization and long-label resilience
guidance: Test labels at expanded lengths
Use logical properties when direction may change
Let essential controls reflow rather than truncate silently
avoid: Fixed widths based on English copy

title: Semantic component state coverage
guidance: Derive required states from interaction semantics
Keep focus visible and programmatic state accurate
Expose asynchronous progress and outcome without relying on color
avoid: Mechanical state lists for inert elements
